+++ Insanely fun gameplay
+++ Fantastic soundtrack
++ Great artstyle
++ Great zones with many secrets
++ A lot of weapons, stats, upgrades, synergies
+ Nice classes

After beating Guardian 4 with an S-Rank I gotta say: This game is insane!
The gameplay is such responsive, quick, adrenalin-pumping FUN, that it gets outright addicting. Playing a HUGE part is the soundtrack, which is fantastic. There is not a single bad track, and I even downloaded a few to my phone! The artstyle looks great: it is simple, but readable, distinct, but charming. A perfefct mix for this type of game. The zones/levels are all around amazing, as they are very distinct from one another. Going through the levels on Discovery difficulty and hunting secrets was a lot of fun, and very rewarding as new levels and areas can be unlocked as well. There are a lot of weapons, stats, upgrades, and synergies, which make every run feel unique. Adding to this are the classes, which are pretty different from each other.

This love letter to first person shooters and rogue-likes with the pace and music of doom and weapon customisation of borderlands will keep you on your toes constantly. You'd be doing yourself a disservice to not give this game an honest try

I want to love this game so much but it's just hard to. I first saw this game at my friends house and he loves it too but did't recommended it to me. I was confused since it looked fun and good but at the same time I see no ads on it as much as I thought it should until I bought it and started playing it. The game mechanics do not match you skill level if you are good at rogue like games and have good reflex you will still suck at this game. No matter the difficulty this game is what make it trash mechanics is the bait-y it is. Your heal cell which are like health potions on the floor disappear after a few seconds and by a few it's like 2-3 if you are being bombarded by an array of arsenals its very difficult to pick them up. So you lose on healing but it doesn't mater because they heal for like 2 hp when you have like 240 hp to start with and the enemy hit for like 20 plus damage. Whats worse is that if you do manage to be amazing and dodge like your life depends on it this game will lead you into a battle arena room you cannot escape from, and make you fight a horde of bots that will either deal so much damage that you will be very angry when its all finish because half you health is gone or you will die depending on how much health you had going in. And all of this is in the standard difficulty! It would be bearable if the Heal cells were 5 hp to recover. At this point I would not recommend this game to anyone, You are better off playing Fortnite against sweaty hacker and you would still have a better time than playing this game at standard difficulty...
